post.description: You need the complaint detail behind a business's complaint counts, filtered by status (answered, resolved, unanswered) or type.

complaint_type.description:
bbb.org complaint type slug (see `available_filters.type` of a previous page).

Provider reference: allowed values ["productissues", "serviceorrepair", "delivery", "billingissues", "customerservice", "salesadvertising", "order", "guarantee", "other"].

id.description: BBB identity `<bbbId>-<businessId>` as it appears at the end of the profile URL (e.g. 0825-1000223803). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{1,12}$.

page.description:
1-based page of 10 complaints, newest first.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 200; default 1.

status.description:
bbb.org complaint status filter.

Provider reference: allowed values ["answered", "resolved", "unanswered"].

url.description: A pasted bbb.org business profile URL, or any of its sub pages (/complaints, /customer-reviews, /leave-a-review). Exactly one of `id` or `url`.

200.description:
Published customer complaints for one business from its bbb.org complaints tab, newest first, 10 per page, with complaint type, status, date, text and the business/consumer response thread, plus the status/type filter counts bbb.org offers and the profile's closed-complaint summary.

The response contains the tool result directly.

items.text: Hello,I'm reaching out to escalate a ridiculous runaround I've been getting regarding a $32.06 refund credit that was explicitly promised to me for order #***-4226310-7460223.Two different Amazon support agents put their commitment in writing and confirmed the credit. But instead of honoring what your staff promised, your social media and email teams have completely ignored the proof, claimed it's a "misunderstanding," and started spamming me with blind, automated scripts asking for info I've already provided multiple times.  One of the agents even told me that the refund was issued and sent a confirmation email but it never arrived into my account balance.I have attached the screenshots proving the promised credit, the agent saying they issued the credit, and me being denied the refund I was promised.  Please issue the $32.06 refund that was promised to my account gift card balance.

post.description: Start here to find a business and its `id` for profile / complaints / resolve, or to list businesses in a category and place.

category_id.description: Restrict to one BBB type-of-business id (`filter_category`), taken from a previous search's `filters.categories`. Pattern: ^[0-9]{5}-[0-9]{3}$.

country.description:
Market to search: bbb.org serves the United States and Canada.

Provider reference: allowed values ["USA", "CAN"]; default "USA".

distance_miles.description:
Radius around `location` (`filter_distance`); requires `location`.

Provider reference: allowed values ["5", "10", "25", "50", "100"].

location.description: City and state/province (`Austin, TX`), or a ZIP / postal code (bbb.org `find_loc`). Omit for a nationwide search.

min_rating.description:
Minimum BBB letter grade (`filter_ratings`): A means A and above.

Provider reference: allowed values ["A", "B", "C", "D", "F"].

page.description:
1-based result page of 15 items; bbb.org exposes at most 15 pages per query.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 50; default 1.

query.description: Business name or category words (bbb.org `find_text`). Required unless `category_id` is given.

sort.description:
bbb.org sort order. Distance requires `location`.

Provider reference: allowed values ["Relevance", "Distance", "Rating", "AToZ", "ZToA"]; default "Relevance".

state.description: Restrict to one state/province code (`filter_state`). Pattern: ^[A-Z]{2}$.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Find businesses on bbb.org by name or category words and an optional city/state or postal code, with the site's own filters (accredited only, minimum letter grade, category id, state, radius) and sort. Returns 15 items per page with BBB identity, canonical profile URL, letter grade, accreditation flag, categories, address, phones and service areas, plus the filter values bbb.org offers.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `items` as the primary payload key.
